description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance within a supportive environment.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and fostering a positive clinical culture. This position offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 to $75,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence in long-term care.

If you are a compassionate leader with a strong clinical background and a desire to make a significant impact on resident well-being, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Previous supervisory or leadership experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $60,000 to $75,000 annually, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Director Legal, also serving as an Associate General Counsel, to join a dynamic remote-first organization. This pivotal role involves providing expert legal counsel and guidance on a wide range of corporate matters, ensuring compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, and mitigating legal risks across the business.

The ideal candidate will play a critical role in shaping legal strategies, managing complex legal projects, and supporting various departments with sound legal advice. This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned legal professional to contribute significantly to a growing and innovative company.
requirements: Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school
Active bar admission in at least one U.S. state
Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive legal experience, with a preference for in-house counsel experience
Demonstrated expertise in corporate law, contracts, and regulatory compliance
Exceptional analytical, communication, and negotiation skills
